The '''Imperial Quartermaster-General''' was a role within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Quartermaster-General was responsible for buying supplies for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], such as crops.<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
